name: Global mean surface temperature, 1991–2020 monthly climatology

source.dataset: Berkeley Earth Land/Ocean Temperature Record (Land_and_Ocean_complete.txt; land analysis 04-Jan-2025, HadSST4 ocean)
references: Rohde and Hausfather 2020, Earth Syst. Sci. Data 12, 3469–3479
source.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://berkeleyearth.org/data/); attribute to Berkeley Earth

mask: none: land air temperature, sea-surface temperature over open ocean, air temperature over sea ice
definition: °C, month m at index m − 1: the record's 1951–1980 absolute climatology (global 14.102 ± 0.019 °C) plus the month's mean anomaly over 1991–2020. The model's matching quantity is the surface skin temperature (surfaceT) from the run's day means, area-weighted over the globe.
